messages:
rae: Quick follow-up from the allocator sync — capturing a narrow change we can ship without touching the admission surface much.
tom: Sounds good. Goal: split decision logic (who gets tokens) into a separate allocator, but keep admission as the final gate.
anya: Minimal API idea: POST /v1/leases {tenant_id, want, priority?, weight? , abuse_hint?} -> {granted, id, reason_code, ttl}. reason_code enum needed for metrics.
hannah: Important: abuse_hint must be advisory unless signed by our detector. For hosted we validate signatures; for onprem we log untrusted hints.
rae: Caching: admission may cache short leases for interactive paths only. TTL < allocator replenishment window and invalidation on notify.
tom: Fallbacks if allocator unreachable: 1) cached lease 2) per-tenant emergency quota 3) degraded strict-throttle mode + clear error code. No silent allow.
anya: Telemetry to add: leases.requests, leases.grants, leases.rejections_by_reason, leases.latency_p95, fairness.adjustment, abuse.penalty.count. Sampled debug events (hashed tenant) for replay.
hannah: Tests: fairness determinism, signed-abuse verification, allocator-down chaos.
ops-bot: deploy: allocator-shim/v0.1 staged at 4805001245
rae: Action items: @hannah proto + enum (EOD), @tom metrics + dashboards (48h), @anya canary plan (72h). I'll open RFC after proto lands.
Tom: ack.
